settings.refresh.label: Refresh interval
settings.refresh.description: Seconds between OpenCode Go checks (60–900). GitHub Copilot is checked at most every 10 minutes.
settings.background_mode.label: Panel background
settings.background_mode.description: Fixed black (like msbos AI Chat) or the theme background.
settings.background_opacity.label: Background opacity
settings.background_opacity.description: How dark the panel black is (0–100).
panel.title: Agent Usage
panel.overage: Overage allowed: usage above the quota is billed separately.
error.no_key: No OpenCode credential. Run: opencode auth login
error.expired: Credential expired. Run: opencode auth login
error.no_sqlite: sqlite3 not found (install the sqlite package).
error.unauthorized: Invalid credential (401). Run: opencode auth login
error.no_plan: Go plan not found (403). Check the dashboard.
error.no_usage: Invalid API response. Showing last cache.
error.cp_no_key: No Copilot credential. Run: opencode auth login github-copilot
error.cp_auth: Invalid Copilot credential (401). Run: opencode auth login github-copilot
error.cp_forbidden: Copilot refused the request (403): seat/entitlement or too many requests.
error.cp_gone: Copilot internal endpoint unavailable (404): the API changed.
error.cp_http: Copilot API failure (HTTP {code}). Showing last cache.
error.cp_offline: No connection to GitHub. Showing last cache.
error.cp_no_usage: Unexpected Copilot response. Showing last cache.
